verdicts.decision_note: The client identifies concrete wizard UI specifications for typography, colors, active-step styling, controls, panel dimensions, assets, and portrait/landscape layout.
The active-node color and several concrete visual tokens and dimensions remain materially undecided.

The client replaces the detailed wizard visual specification with a simpler informational-page treatment requiring a background and header logo, with an optional footer; the removed keys exist in prior state and do not overlap the updates.
The simplified visual treatment supersedes the previously unresolved detailed styling choices, allowing the styling Requirement to return to active status.
The client specifies reuse of the Cognito sign-in background and limits the implementation obligation to styling the already functional provisioning wizard.
